options.name: extra_zfs_properties
options.description: A dictionary of zfs properties to be set. See the zfs(8) man page for more information.

options.name: name
options.description: File system, snapshot or volume name, for example V(rpool/myfs).

options.name: origin
options.description: Snapshot from which to create a clone.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether to create (V(present)), or remove (V(absent)) a file system, snapshot or volume. All parents/children are created/destroyed as needed to reach the desired state.
